title: Comprehensive bioinformatics analysis and experimental verification identify mitochondrial gene Dgat2 as a novel therapeutic biomarker for myocardial ischemia-reperfusion.
authors: Li, Hong; Zhou, Yixin; Xue, Wenya; Yin, Pan; Liu, Luyu; Wu, Shaobo; Zhao, Yahao; An, Qi; Sun, Yang
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学与实验验证鉴定心肌缺血再灌注中线粒体基因Dgat2作为生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子预测但非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ischemic cardiomyopathy is a severe disease marked by high morbidity and mortality, often exacerbated by myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury (MI/RI). Mitochondrial metabolism plays a critical role in MI/RI progression. This study aimed to identify potential new targets and biomarkers for mitochondria-related genes in MI/RI. METHODS: MI/R microarray data (GSE160516) from the GEO database and a mitochondrial geneset were analyzed. Limma identified differentially expressed genes (DEGs), followed by GSEA, GO, and KEGG pathway enrichment. Mitochondria-related DEGs (MitoDEGs) were pinpointed. Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) networks and machine learning identified key MitoDEGs. Regulatory networks were constructed using transcription factor (TF) predictions. Immune cell infiltration was assessed with ImmuCelAl, and correlations between MitoDEGs and immune cell levels were examined. Mouse myocardial ischemia-reperfusion models were established to validate pivotal MitoDEGs. RESULTS: MitoDEGs were enriched in bio-oxidation, immune-inflammation, and oxidative stress pathways. Machine learning identified two hub genes: Dgat2 and Cybb. Dgat2 was significantly elevated in ischemia-reperfusion mouse models, confirmed by RT-PCR and Western blot. Functional enrichment indicated that Dgat2 may be involved in biological oxidation and lipid metabolism. TF prediction suggested PPARG as a regulator of Dgat2 expression. Immune infiltration analysis revealed significant correlations between Dgat2 and immune cells, including CD4_T_cells and NK cells, suggesting a role for immunity in MI/RI. CONCLUSIONS: We found that Dgat2 could be exploited as a novel mitochondria-related gene target and biomarker in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, which is of great clinical significance.
abstract_zh: 背景：缺血性心肌病是一种以高发病率和死亡率为特征的严重疾病，常因心肌缺血/再灌注损伤（MI/RI）而加重。线粒体代谢在MI/RI进展中发挥关键作用。本研究旨在识别MI/RI中线粒体相关基因的潜在新靶点和生物标志物。方法：分析了来自GEO数据库的MI/R微阵列数据（GSE160516）及线粒体基因集。使用Limma识别差异表达基因（DEGs），随后进行GSEA、GO和KEGG通路富集分析。精确定位了线粒体相关DEGs（MitoDEGs）。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络和机器学习识别关键MitoDEGs。利用转录因子（TF）预测构建调控网络。使用ImmuCelAl评估免疫细胞浸润，并检查MitoDEGs与免疫细胞水平之间的相关性。建立小鼠心肌缺血-再灌注模型以验证关键MitoDEGs。结果：MitoDEGs富集于生物氧化、免疫炎症和氧化应激通路。机器学习识别出两个枢纽基因：Dgat2和Cybb。在缺血-再灌注小鼠模型中，Dgat2显著升高，并通过RT-PCR和Western blot确认。功能富集表明Dgat2可能参与生物氧化和脂质代谢。TF预测提示PPARG为Dgat2表达的调控因子。免疫浸润分析显示Dgat2与免疫细胞（包括CD4_T细胞和NK细胞）之间存在显著相关性，提示免疫在MI/RI中的作用。结论：我们发现Dgat2可作为心肌缺血-再灌注损伤中新型线粒体相关基因靶点和生物标志物，具有重要的临床意义。
